newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan to announce land liquidity steps on Monday.
newsitem.headline: Japan to announce land liquidity steps on Monday.

text.p: The Japanese government is expected to announce on Monday afternoon a set of measures to boost liquidity in the country's land market, a government official said on Friday.
Finance Minister Hiroshi Mitsuzuka has said measures to improve land liquidity will focus on securitising collateralised land.
It is aimed at helping the beleaguered banking sector, which is saddled with a mountain of bad loans, many of them made to the real estate sector and using property as collateral.
